R8, conformance-gate.md §1). Regenerating this file is a SPEC-LEVEL
behavioral event requiring a new feature or amendment — NEVER a fix
for a red gate. A byte diff at any migration/conformance gate is
ALWAYS resolved by fixing crates/pool-rules to reproduce THESE bytes
(behavior freeze beats correctness; TS bugs port as-is, filed apart).

byte-changing corpus erratum under the docs/rules/variants.md par.4
protocol: 40 expects regenerated through the pool-cli judge leg
(each carries a per-case comment naming its clause) — CITE
corrections ONLY, vs the pinned editions (WPA eff. 2025-09-15 /
WPBSA Revised Sept 2024 / UMB 1 Jan 1989): no-contact WPA
3.2 -> 3.3 (14 nineball + 3 eightball incl. the break chain);
snooker Sec2 R13 -> R11 (ball-on def), Sec3 R8 -> R5 (in-hand),

cases); carom Art 23.2 -> 23.1(c) error payloads (4 cases). The
batch's one behavior arm (onepocket/judge-023-legal-pot, '12.6 is
spot timing only, a neutral-pocket table-clear passes') was
REFUTED on the verbatim 12.6 text and reverted to the ORIGINAL
frozen bytes — 12.6 explicitly grants 'the shooter continues
their turn' on the cleared table (issue #62 adjudication; full
record: the playable-disciplines research notes, R9 item 4).
hudState/applyDecision expects that merely ECHO old-cite
foulContext from INPUT states are echoes, not emissions —
untouched by design. All other cases byte-identical (CI proves it).

legal boundaries (different cushion first; ball first) -- same
current-crate-harvest discipline as above.
